entry.title: Sun Grown Maduro Robusto
entry.eyebrow: Broadleaf Maduro counterpart to Sun Grown
entry.summaryHtml: Dark-roasted coffee, earth, cocoa, caramel, black licorice and pepper make the Sun Grown Maduro darker and sweeter than the standard Ecuadorian-Sumatra Sun Grown line. The oily Broadleaf wrapper sits over a Nicaraguan core, giving the Robusto dense body, roasted sweetness and a peppery finish without losing the line’s dry, earthy backbone.

note: Add the Maduro counterpart to the existing Rocky Patel Sun Grown line as a standalone blend entry. The Index currently has both the single and box of 20 available; the box gives the best verified Australian per-stick price at A$45.30.
